name: bld3_card_abelianization_of_card_prime_cube
statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a) : Nat.card (Abelianization G) = p ^ 2
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (G : Type*) [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = p ^ 3) (hna : ∃ a b : G, a * b ≠ b * a), Nat.card (Abelianization G) = p ^ 2
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_commutator_eq_center_of_card_prime_cube and Mathlib2.bld_center_card_of_card_prime_cube: Abelianization G = G ⧸ commutator G, the commutator subgroup equals the centre, which has order p; Lagrange gives index p^2.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G], Nat.card G = p ^ 3 → (∃ a b, a * b ≠ b * a) → Nat.card (Abelianization G) = p ^ 2
